questions.question: Which spelling is correct?
questions.explanation: Correct: fad. It is a short base word with one final d; no suffix is being added, so there is no reason to double it. Fadd incorrectly inserts an extra consonant. Transfer: only double a final consonant when a spelling rule or the established word requires it.
